items.question: What mercy is being requested from the goddess of gods so that the speakers may not delight in actions here?
premises: speakers ask the goddess for mercy
they do not delight in actions here
mercy is sought to turn from action
items.inference: The verse petitions divine grace to withdraw delight from worldly action.

items.plain_english: O goddess of gods, do that mercy; we do not delight in actions here.
